decision_scope: Bounded acceptance of the pinned, parent-transcribed read-only capability evidence at its observation time only

reconstruction.method: Extract the raw WORKER_SOURCE literal from the previously accepted source retained in this review session and concatenate the exact pinned suffix; do not execute either program or reread broader sources

shown_by_source_inspection: The sole terminate_worker invocation supplies real os, ObservationOnly, time and read_only. The accepted source's signal_api.pidfd_send_signal call therefore reaches ObservationOnly.pidfd_send_signal, which reads /proc/self/fdinfo/<fd> and updates fixed observation fields only.

Real os.pidfd_open and os.close are used for the self and worker handles. Their zero arguments are pidfd flags, not a signal-zero invocation. The reconstructed program does not invoke real signal.pidfd_send_signal, os.kill or another real signal operation.
The suffix inspects real signal API presence with callable/getattr but does not call that API. API existence and successful pidfd opens do not establish send permission or delivery.

Identity command-line bytes are read internally through bounded read-only files. The only result print is an explicit JSON projection of time, capabilities, validation status, fixed failure stage, worker PID/handle status, Python version and fixed disclosure booleans; no argv or environment values are exported, and environment is not read.

captured_native_evidence.origin: Parent-performed native observation, sanitized stdout transcribed into the pinned JSON; accepted as supplied evidence, not independently repeated or authenticated against a separate raw transcript
captured_native_evidence.recorded_sequence: Seven-original inspect, four application probes, same seven-original inspect

clock_interpretation.offset_definition: Remote epoch sample minus host time: lower = remote - host response, upper = remote - host request, conditional on sampling order and clock behavior during the bracket
clock_interpretation.interpretation: Each recorded bracket is compatible with zero offset and weighs against gross skew at that sample. It does not measure an exact zero offset, ongoing synchronization or a future deadline guarantee.
clock_interpretation.independent_arithmetic_limit: The JSON omits the raw remote_utc_epoch values emitted by the suffix. Review checked interval ordering, inclusion of zero and widths against recorded host brackets, not recomputation of both endpoints from separately retained remote samples.

nonblocking_provenance_limits.claim: The parent reports interpreter isolation with -I -S -B. The three permitted artifacts do not retain an exact exec argv, and a program hash alone cannot prove launch flags. This review does not independently promote those invocation flags to SHOWN.

The JSON records selected metadata equality and one original inventory, not two separate raw inspect payloads. Equality is a supplied capture result, not an independent before/after recomparison by this reviewer; it does not prove full configuration or persistent-data preservation.

remaining_unverified: Actual pidfd signal permission and delivery, including successful graceful worker and shell/container exit.
Acknowledgement survival on PID1 exit and actual cancellation, transport-loss, pending ownership and recovery behavior.
Exact or future clock synchronization, ongoing clock compatibility and any approved deadline tolerance.
A real cited explanation response, historical failure substep, persistent-record contents and volume contents.
disclosed_parent_side_effects: Four temporary exec processes and Docker execution events.
